# 1 Enoch Chapter 50 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 50:1 — "light of days" vs. "light of eternity"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "light of-days" | Literal; Ge'ez berhāna māwāʿel |
| LOGOS | "light of days" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "light of eternity" | Interprets "days" as eternal duration |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Light of days" (LOGOS). The Ge'ez phrase is slightly ambiguous but the literal "days" is better preserved. PNEUMA's "eternity" is an interpretation.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 50:2 — "forgo the works of their hands" vs. "abandon the works" vs. "turn away from everything"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "forgo-the-works of-their-hands" | Literal; "works of hands" = idols |
| LOGOS | "abandon the works of their hands" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "turn away from everything they have done" | Loses the "hands" idiom |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Abandon the works of their hands" (LOGOS). The "works of their hands" is a standard Hebrew/Ge'ez idiom for idolatry (Deut 4:28; Isa 2:8) and must be retained.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 50:3 — "unrighteousness also shall not maintain itself" vs. "shall not sustain itself"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "unrighteousness-also-shall-not-maintain-itself" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "unrighteousness shall not sustain itself" | "Sustain" more natural |
| PNEUMA | "unrighteousness cannot stand" | Simplest English idiom |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Unrighteousness shall not sustain itself" (LOGOS). "Cannot stand" (PNEUMA) is too brief and loses the reflexive sense of self-preservation implied by the Ge'ez.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

**Total disagreements: 3**
